title: trailboss --json recap
description: What sessions did while you were away: the session named, else every session with unread turns (an empty array when there's none). The window runs from --since (else when you last saw the session: the later of when you marked it seen and your last prompt to it; else 30 minutes ago) until now. Recap only reads.

title.description: The session's title, as `live` and `sessions` show it.

host.description: The host its terminal is in; null when it isn't running in one.

terminal.description: Its terminal; null when it isn't running in one.

since_ms.description: Start of the window, in ms since the epoch.

until_ms.description: End of the window (now), in ms since the epoch.

turns.description: Turns it finished in the window.

files.description: Files its own tools changed in the window (as `changes --session` counts them).

commands.description: Shell commands it ran in the window.

checks.description: Commands among them that look like tests or builds, by short name (`cargo test`, `npm run build`), each once, in the order last run.

passed.description: Whether its last run passed, from its exit status; absent when the transcript doesn't say, or its result isn't written.

state.description: working, needs you, done (at rest after its turn) or ended (not running); more may be added.

said.description: The first line of its last reply, at most 200 characters.

context_pct.description: As `live` says, while it runs; else null.

line.description: The one-line summary, e.g. `api while you were away (42m): 3 turns, 6 files, 11 commands, cargo test passed, at prompt`.
